entries.06d0f30ab83315c3: Its strength lies in having entered the job-hunting support market for kosen students ahead of competitors and built close networks and cooperative relationships with technical college faculty. Job-hunting events are sometimes held as school events or as part of classes, and through a system in which the company group works with faculty to handle everything from confirming attendance on the day to arranging transportation to the venue through travel agencies, it achieves events with a high participation rate among kosen students. Through the official guidebook, which delivers company information in advance, and 'Kosen Plus', it also provides a mechanism that allows both students and companies to gather information and make contact efficiently.
entries.07d896e1f1ff865b: Its main customers are companies in manufacturing, information and communications, construction and other industries that recruit kosen students, and technical colleges and universities that commission the operation of job-hunting events. In the WEB Content Service Business, it receives production commissions from corporate customers.

entries.0cdcbaa7a45264f0: It hosts the job-hunting event for kosen (technical college) students, "Job Research Seminar for Kosen Students," in 7 districts nationwide, and also undertakes the operation of school-hosted events, operates the career support information site "Kosen Plus," and provides recruitment consulting. Together with its consolidated subsidiary Adwill, it also produces WEB sites and videos for corporate clients.
entries.13960dec114600fd: It holds industry seminars specializing in science and engineering several times a year in major cities such as Tokyo and Osaka, providing opportunities to match mainly students from regional science and engineering universities with companies headquartered in major cities, and receives exhibition fees from companies. When it is contracted to run job-hunting events conducted by individual universities, it receives operating fees from the universities. It also holds career exchange meetings open only to female science and engineering students.

entries.2f31f74a1d5c5bfe: It upholds the management philosophy "Making the world flat through innovation and innovation talent," and takes as its mission creating a society in which job hunting does not depend on economic conditions or companies' hiring environment. In its medium- to long-term management strategy, its priority measures are focusing on career support for kosen students and expanding WEB content services. In career support for kosen students, centered on job-hunting events and the career support information site "Kosen Plus" covering 58 technical colleges nationwide and the year-round, accompanying-style "Kosen Talent Recruitment Project," it says it will also proceed with seminars themed on growth industries such as semiconductors and defense. In WEB content services, it has launched "Chokketsu Saiyo" (Direct-Link Recruitment), a service that visualizes a company's appeal and connects it directly to hiring, and its policy is to develop it into a new growth driver through synergies and cross-selling with the Career Support Business.

entries.72dd4b9e9c155135: Of net sales of ¥1,633 million for the fiscal year ended July 2026, the Career Support Business accounted for most at ¥1,373 million, and the WEB Content Service Business for ¥260 million. As a leading company in the field of kosen students' job hunting, the group aims to continue high growth by expanding sales in related businesses. In the human resources and job placement industry, demand for securing personnel is expected over the medium to long term against the background of a declining working-age population due to the falling birthrate and aging population, and demand for specialized personnel in science, engineering and technical fields in particular is described as remaining solid.
